description: Read-only AccessProof production security gates A-J for one organization/application.

runCommand: test "$SELF" = "i-0c11427d4d9c1b438" || { echo "Wrong production instance; refusing" >&2; exit 2; }
test -n "${SSM_organizationId:-}" && test -n "${SSM_applicationId:-}" || { echo "SSM agent does not support ENV_VAR interpolation; refusing" >&2; exit 2; }

state() { c=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml ps -q "$1" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$c" ]; then docker inspect "$c" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; s=json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["State"]; print((s.get("Health") or {}).get("Status") or s.get("Status", "unknown"))'; else echo missing; fi; }
HEAD_REV=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T api alembic heads 2>/dev/null | awk '/\(head\)/{print $1}')
DB_REV=$(docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T db psql -U accessproof -d accessproof -tAc "select version_num from alembic_version" | tr -d "[:space:]")

BUNDLE=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=sys.argv[1:]; print(json.dumps({"host_facts": {"api_healthy": a[0]=="healthy", "worker_running": a[1] in ("running","healthy"), "db_healthy": a[2]=="healthy", "redis_healthy": a[3]=="healthy", "web_healthy": a[4]=="healthy", "migration_at_head": bool(a[5]) and a[5]==a[6], "rollback_available": int(a[7])>0}, "evidence": None}))' "$(state api)" "$(state worker)" "$(state db)" "$(state redis)" "$(state web)" "$HEAD_REV" "$DB_REV" "$ROLLBACKS")

printf %s "$BUNDLE" | docker compose -f docker-compose.ec2.yml exec -T api python scripts/production_security_gates.py --organization-id "$SSM_organizationId" --application-id "$SSM_applicationId" --stdin-bundle
